profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (TN visa)
profile.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
•	+7 Years as a Team Leader in JAVA (8,17,21) technologies and Front-end technologies. 
•	+6 years as an Enterprise Architecture Designer. 
•	+7 Principal Software Engineer 
•	+8 years of experience as a Scrum Master.  
•	+10 Business Analyst.
•	+12 Java technologies (J2EE, SOA, REST, Spring 6, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, Spring batch, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Stream API, Lambda functionalities.).      
•	+5 in Angular (2,4,8,17)  using NPM and Angular Cli.
•	+4 in VUEJS 2 using NPM. 
•	+4 Docker, OpenShift, AWS USING AWS, EC2, ROUTER 53, C3, RDS, AMI, IAM.   
•	+6 years developing Services in Soap, Rest, Spring Cloud, Active MQ, Rest template and feign. 
•	+9 years of experience developing HTLM, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, PRIMENG, ANGULAR, VUEJS.
•	+1 years using Python with  MCP connected with LLM (GPT)  


TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Continuous Planning Tools:	Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps.
Cloud:	                                AWS, EC2, ROUTER, C3, RDS, AMI, IAM, OpenShift
Source Control Tools:	        Bitbucket, GitHub, Gitlab
Orchestration and Container Tools:	Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift
Programming Languages and Tools:	JAVA, Java Script, Typescript, AWK, Shell, SQL, Spring, Spring 
                                                                boot, Spring Data, Spring batch, spring actuator and spring boot 
                                                                 admin
Databases:	                    Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL Server, Postgres, Maria DB
Micro services:	            Spring cloud (SOA, REST).
Front end:	                    JSF, JSP, STRUTS, HTML5, EXTJS, ANGULAR (4,8,17), VUEJS.
Testing:	                             karma, protector, Testbed, Junit, Mokito.
Reports:	                            JASPER, IREPORT, BIRT, POI.
Business Analysis:  	            SCRUM, RUP and UML
Messaging:	                    Rabbit MQ, Kafka
Servers:	                           Tomcat, WebLogic
Continuous Monitoring Tools:	Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Data Dog, jMeter, CloudWatch.
Repositories:	                   Maven, Gradel, Npm


EDUCATION:
•	Bachelor of Science:  Electronics Engineering, UAM

CERTIFICATIONS:
Scrum Master Certified
Oracle Certified Expert, Java EE 6 Web Services Developer: 
Java Programmer 6: 
SQL Fundamental Oracle

positions.title: Sr. Java Backend Developer
positions.description:
•	Development and design of microservices using spring boot and OpenShift and thread Pool. 
•	Increase the  performance of the application using  spring actuator, spring boot admin and appDynamics. in order to check the performace of the application and implementing  the fix for the application.
•	creation of jobs in order to get information of the tables and Passing to Redis Cache in order to decrease the latency using thread Pool.
•	We are using agile methodologies in order to develop the application.
•	Junit and Mockito for the unit test. The application is validated using SonarQube, Nexus, and Fortify, Git Copilot.
Environment: Java 21, 17, 8, Spring boot, Redis, SonarQube, Nexus, Fortify, AWS, Junit, OpenShift, Mockito, Microservices, Agile.

positions.description:
Design of architecture Savi Colombia application using microservices and angular.
Analysis and Creation of functional requirements for Savi Colombia,IPMO.
Business Analyst for the requirement of the area (RPA, Applications).
RPA projects: business analyst of requirements in order in order to create RPA process with the clients (Huawei- ATT, Huawei-Telmex, Huawei-TigoUNE Colombia)
Responsibilities:
• Designer the current architecture that is micro services using Spring boot, java 8, with angular, vuejs, prime NG,
• Analysis and Creation of functional requirements for different projects.
• In charge about the Definition for the new projects and technical leader.
• BPM application design of the architecture application using micro services, angular 4, spring boot, Java 8, Stream API, Lambda functionalities, Spring Stream (Rabbit MQ and Kafka).

• Designer of the dashboard of the application using ChartJS, ECHARTS.
Environment: Java 8, MySQL, PrimeUI, Drop wizard, JPA, Freemarker, Jquery, Angular 4 and Spring Boot, primeNG, Vuejs 2, Spring Stream (Rabit MQ).
Tools: Eclipse, Maven, Jenkins, GIT, GRADLE.
